regulatorySource: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended
applicableClause: Rule 6(1)(e); see Rule 6(1)(g)(C) and the Rule 6(1)(e) provisos
applicabilityConditions: Confirm the package is a pre-packaged commodity within the retail-package provisions.
applicabilityExemptions: Rule 3 excludes certain non-retail, industrial/institutional and bulk packages (generally above 25 kg or 25 L, subject to stated exceptions).
Rule 26 exclusions include quantities of 10 g or 10 ml or less, certain restaurant/hotel fast-food packages, and specified drug formulations; tobacco products are treated separately under that rule.
Rule 6(1)(e) provisos for alcoholic beverages or spirituous liquor and prices fixed for essential commodities; Rule 6(1)(g)(C) also lists bidi and certain LPG packages.

regulatorySource: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended; food-specific requirements are outside this MVP
applicabilityConditions: The food-article proviso points to the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and rules made under it; those food-package date requirements are not assessed by this Rule 6 check.
applicabilityExemptions: Rule 6(1)(d) contains a food-article proviso pointing to separate food-safety requirements; these are not assessed by this Legal Metrology MVP.
Other Rule 6(1)(g) product-specific exceptions and Rule 3 / Rule 26 exclusions may apply, including certain non-retail, industrial/institutional, bulk, small-quantity and food-service packages.
